info.name: Tripz Backend API
info.description:
Hand-crafted collection for the Tripz B2B travel marketplace backend.

## Quick Start

1. Import this file and the matching environment file (`tripz-postman-environment.json`) into Postman.
2. Select the **Tripz Local** environment from the top-right dropdown.
3. **Edit the environment** — set `testVendorEmail`, `testVendorPassword`, `testOtp` etc. to YOUR real test values.
4. Run **Auth > Login** — `accessToken` and `refreshToken` are auto-saved to the environment.
5. All authed requests use `{{accessToken}}` via the collection-level Bearer auth.

## Why request bodies use {{variables}}

Request bodies pull email/password/phone/otp from the ENVIRONMENT, not hardcoded in the collection. This way you can RE-IMPORT the collection any time you add a new endpoint, and YOUR test values stay safe in the environment.

**Edit values in:** Environment tab → eye icon (👁) → CURRENT VALUE column.

## Conventions

- Collection-level Bearer auth attaches `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` to every authed request.
- Path variables like `{{leadId}}`, `{{vendorId}}`, `{{assignmentId}}` are auto-saved by Tests scripts after the first successful list/create call.
- The 3-step password reset flow auto-saves `resetToken` on the verify-OTP step.

item.name: Public — Subscription Plans
item.description:
Public-facing pricing catalog. No authentication required — anyone browsing the marketing site or landing page can see the plans before signing up.

Returns the same data as the vendor-authenticated `/vendor/subscription-plans` endpoint (only active + non-deleted plans, ordered by displayOrder).

request.description:
Returns the live plan catalog for the marketing/pricing page.

**Filter rules (server-side, automatic):**
- `isActive = true`
- `deletedAt IS NULL`
- Ordered by `displayOrder ASC`, then `offerPriceInPaise ASC`

**Response shape:** same as `GET /vendor/subscription-plans` — every plan carries `action: "BUY"` and `currentSubscription` is `null` because there is no vendor context on the public route. See the frontend contract for the full field-by-field breakdown.

item.name: Public — Packages (marketplace browse)
item.description:
Public-facing package catalog. No authentication — customers browse without signing up.

**Server-side filters (automatic):**
- `status = 'APPROVED'` only
- `deletedAt IS NULL`
- EVERGREEN packages always shown; SEASONAL packages shown only when today is between startDate and endDate

Prices are in **paise** (INR × 100). Frontend divides by 100 for display.

request.description:
Enable the query params to filter.

**packageRegion values:** NATIONAL / INTERNATIONAL

**packageType values:** HONEYMOON / FAMILY / HOLIDAY / COUPLE / SOLO / GROUP / ADVENTURE / RELIGIOUS / BEACH / HILL_STATION / WILDLIFE / CULTURAL / CORPORATE / OTHER

**validityType values:** EVERGREEN / SEASONAL

**sortBy:** `createdAt` | `priceInPaise` | `title`

SEO-friendly URL — slug is auto-generated from title (e.g., `kashmir`, `kashmir-2` on collision).

Returns 404 if the slug doesn't exist, is deleted, or is not APPROVED.

item.name: Vendor — Packages
item.description:
Vendor package CRUD + lifecycle. VENDOR role.

**Workflow:** DRAFT → SUBMITTED → APPROVED (or REJECTED → back to DRAFT). Approved packages can be self-PAUSED/resumed by the vendor without re-review.

**Image upload:** Frontend uploads each image to `/uploads/image` first (`purpose: 'package-main'` or `'package-gallery'`), receives Cloudinary URL back, then sends URLs in the package create/update body — either as a plain string OR as the wrapper object the upload endpoint returns.

query.description: true (default) → DRAFT with lenient validation. false → SUBMITTED with strict validation.

request.description:
Creates a new package.

**`?draft` query flag drives BOTH validation and initial status:**

| `?draft` | Validator | Required fields | Initial status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `true` (default) | **Lenient** | only `title` | DRAFT |
| `false` | **Strict** | title, destination, overview, packageType, packageRegion, mainImage, price | SUBMITTED |

Draft-mode: vendor can save with just `{ "title": "Kashmir" }` and iterate later via PATCH. Completeness is enforced later when they call `POST /:id/submit`.

Both flavours count against `plan.maxPackages`.

**Key notes:**
- `price`, `oldPrice`, `discount` accept strings or numbers — backend converts rupees → paise.
- `mainImage` and `galleryImages` accept plain URL strings OR the wrapper object returned by `/uploads/image`.
- `SEASONAL` validityType requires both `startDate` and `endDate` (enforced in strict mode; in draft mode, must both be present or both absent).
- Client can safely include extra fields (`agent`, `status`) — they're silently ignored.
- `slug` is auto-generated from `title`.

**Subscription gate — creation is blocked when:**
- 403 `NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION` — vendor has no active plan or the current one has expired.
- 403 `PACKAGE_LIMIT_REACHED` — vendor is at `plan.maxPackages`. Payload includes `currentPackages`, `maxPackages`, `planName`. `maxPackages: -1` means unlimited.

Active-package count is `DRAFT + SUBMITTED + APPROVED + PAUSED` (REJECTED and soft-deleted packages don't count).

**Side effect:** Auto-saves `packageId` and `packageSlug` for follow-up calls.

exec: console.log('Auto-saved minimal draft:', res.data.id, '| slug:', res.data.slug);

request.description:
Demonstrates the lenient draft path — vendor saves progress with only a title, then fills the rest later.

**Response:** `status: DRAFT`. The row is fully valid at the schema level but the completeness check will catch missing required fields on `/submit`.

**Follow-up flow:**
1. PATCH `/vendor/packages/:id` — add more fields over time.
2. POST `/vendor/packages/:id/submit` — service runs `getMissingRequiredFields`; if anything's missing, returns 400 `PACKAGE_INCOMPLETE` with a `missingFields` list.

query.description: Submit directly — skip DRAFT, go straight to admin queue.

request.description:
SEASONAL packages MUST have startDate + endDate. Once endDate passes, the package auto-hides from public marketplace (query-level filter).

**This request uses `?draft=false`** — package is created directly in SUBMITTED status (admin queue). Change to `?draft=true` (or omit) to keep it as a draft.

**Validation errors:**
- 400 — SEASONAL missing startDate/endDate
- 400 — endDate before startDate
Vendor's own packages (all statuses except soft-deleted).
Full detail of a vendor's own package. Returns 403 if the package belongs to another vendor.

query.description: true (default) → save only. false → save + transition to SUBMITTED.

request.description:
Partial update — status is untouched. Use this while the vendor is still iterating on a DRAFT (or editing an APPROVED / PAUSED package).

**Symmetric with POST `/vendor/packages?draft=true|false`:**
- CREATE `?draft=true` → new row is a DRAFT.
- UPDATE `?draft=true` → existing row stays in its current status.

**Behaviour by current status:**
- **DRAFT / REJECTED:** silent update, stays in the same status.
- **APPROVED / PAUSED:** update is live immediately BUT `hasPendingReview` is flagged — admins see it in the queue with a filter.
- **SUBMITTED:** blocked with 409 `PACKAGE_UNDER_REVIEW` — wait for admin decision first.

Title change auto-regenerates the slug. Empty body is allowed (no-op).

query.description: Save the fields AND flip DRAFT/REJECTED → SUBMITTED in one call.

request.description:
One-shot **save + submit** — the vendor's "Publish" button.

**Symmetric with POST `/vendor/packages?draft=false`:** both endpoints treat `draft=false` as "this is no longer a draft — send it to admin review."

**Backend flow:**
1. Apply the update (may be empty if the vendor already saved everything in prior PATCH calls).
2. Run the completeness check on the resulting row.
3. If every required field is present → transition DRAFT/REJECTED → SUBMITTED (stamps `submittedAt`, clears prior review notes).

**Completeness gate — required fields:** `title`, `destination`, `overview`, `packageType`, `packageRegion`, `mainImageUrl`, `priceInPaise`. `SEASONAL` packages additionally need `startDate` + `endDate`.

Missing any → **400 `PACKAGE_INCOMPLETE`** with the missing fields list. IMPORTANT: fields you sent in this same call **are still saved** — the frontend can highlight the remaining gaps and try again without re-typing.
```
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Package is missing required fields to submit for review.",
  "details": {
    "code": "PACKAGE_INCOMPLETE",
    "missingFields": ["packageType", "mainImageUrl"]
  }
}
```

**Empty body is valid** if the vendor already filled every field via earlier PATCHes — this call just triggers the completeness check + transition.

**Other errors:**
- 403 — package belongs to another vendor
- 404 — package not found
- 409 `PACKAGE_UNDER_REVIEW` — package is already SUBMITTED
- 409 `INVALID_TRANSITION` — package is APPROVED/PAUSED (no re-submit needed; the update just flags `hasPendingReview`)

APPROVED → PAUSED. Hides from public marketplace but preserves the package + admin approval.

**Errors:**
- 409 `INVALID_TRANSITION` — only APPROVED packages can be paused (current status returned in `currentStatus`)

PAUSED → APPROVED. No re-review required. Same endpoint as **Pause package**, just with `paused=false`.

**Errors:**
- 409 `INVALID_TRANSITION` — only PAUSED packages can be resumed

Soft delete — stamps `deletedAt`. The package disappears from all listings (public, vendor, admin) but the row stays for referential integrity with any leads that pointed at it.

**Errors:**
- 409 `ALREADY_DELETED` — package is already soft-deleted

item.name: Admin — Packages
item.description:
Vendor package moderation. ADMIN + SUPER_ADMIN.

Admin sees SUBMITTED packages in the queue, plus a `hasPendingReview` flag on APPROVED packages that were edited after approval — great signal for re-review triage.

request.description:
**status values:** DRAFT / SUBMITTED / APPROVED / REJECTED / PAUSED

**sortBy:** `createdAt` | `updatedAt` | `submittedAt` | `reviewedAt` | `title`

Response includes each package's owning vendor's user info.
Full package detail + vendor user info (name, email, phone).

SUBMITTED → APPROVED. Also clears `hasPendingReview` if it was set (re-review case).

**Errors:**
- 409 `INVALID_TRANSITION` — package is not SUBMITTED

SUBMITTED → REJECTED with reason (5-1000 chars, REQUIRED for vendor to know what to fix).

Vendor can edit + resubmit — REJECTED → SUBMITTED transition allowed via `/vendor/packages/:id/submit`.

**Errors:**

item.name: Auth — Public
item.description: Endpoints that do NOT require an access token. Use these to register, log in, and reset passwords.

request.description:
Self-signup for CLIENT or VENDOR. ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN can only be created by Super Admin via `/super-admin/admins`.

**Body fields:**
- `role` — `CLIENT` or `VENDOR`
- `password` — min 8 chars, must contain upper, lower, digit, special
- `phone` — 10 digits, unique

**Side effect:** Sends an OTP to the email for verification.

Email + password login. Auto-saves `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `userId`, `userRole` to the environment via the Tests script.

**Response for vendors:** includes `vendorProfile.kycStatus` and `vendorProfile.nextStep` so the frontend can decide where to redirect (KYC page vs dashboard).

**Errors:**
- 401 — wrong credentials
- 403 `ACCOUNT_UNDER_REVIEW` — vendor with SUBMITTED KYC
- 403 `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` — email not verified yet (auto-resends OTP)

Single entry point for Google sign-in. Handles 3 cases:
1. Returning Google user → log in
2. Existing email account → auto-link Google identity, log in
3. Brand-new email → create + log in (requires `role`)

`role` is required only for case 3; ignored otherwise.
Trade in your refresh token for a fresh access + refresh token pair (rotates the refresh token). Auto-saves both to the environment.

Consume the email-verification OTP sent on registration. Once verified, `emailVerifiedAt` is set and login becomes possible.

**Body:** `{ email, otp }` — both required. OTP must be 4-10 digits.
Re-issue the email verification OTP (subject to the resend cooldown returned in `otp.resendCooldownSeconds`).

Anti-enumeration endpoint — always returns a generic success message whether the email exists or not. If the account exists, an OTP is emailed.

Response includes `otp` metadata: `{ ttlSeconds, resendCooldownSeconds, maxAttempts, sentAt, expiresAt }` so the UI can render a countdown.

Validates the OTP and returns a short-lived `resetToken` (JWT, ~10 min TTL). Does NOT consume the OTP — that happens in Step 3.

**Body:** `{ email, otp }` — both required.

The Tests script auto-saves the token to `{{resetToken}}`.

Final step. Validates the reset token, consumes the underlying OTP, and updates the password. All existing refresh tokens for this user are revoked.

After this succeeds, the user must log in again with the new password.

item.name: Auth — Authenticated
item.description: Requires a valid `accessToken`. Inherits Bearer auth from collection root.

request.description: Returns the logged-in user's profile. For vendors, includes `vendorProfile.kycStatus` + `vendorProfile.nextStep` (mirror of the login response) so the frontend can redirect after a page refresh.
Revokes the supplied refresh token. The access token continues to work until it expires (~15 min) — frontend should clear it from storage.

item.name: Leads — Public (anonymous form)
item.description:
The travel inquiry form. Works with OR without auth: if a bearer token is present, the lead is linked to that customer; otherwise it's anonymous and auto-linked at registration via email match.

**One endpoint serves three lead flavours** — the request payload decides which flow the backend picks. See individual requests for each variant.

**Rate limit:** 5 inquiries per hour per email (falls back to IP if email is missing). Returns 429 `LEAD_RATE_LIMIT` with `Retry-After` header once exceeded.

request.description:
**Flavour: Global marketplace lead** (no `targetVendorId`, no `packageId`).

Lead is created with `status: PENDING_REVIEW`, `priceInCredits: 10`, `maxUnlocks: 3`. Admin must approve before it appears on the marketplace feed; then any KYC-approved vendor can unlock.

**Body shape:** `{ lead: { ...flat fields... } }`
- `lead` — wizard fields are FLAT inside `lead`, NOT nested in `requirements`. Backend extracts `destination/email/phone/budget/departureCity/travelDate` to top-level columns and bundles everything else into the `requirements` JSONB column.

**Auth behaviour (optional):** if a valid bearer token is sent → `customerUserId` = user id. If missing/invalid → anonymous lead. Anonymous leads are later auto-linked when a customer registers with the same email.

**Type coercion:**
- `adults/children/infants` — accepts `"2"` or `2` (string or int)
- `flightRequired/cabRequired/otherDestinations` — accepts `"YES"`/`"NO"`/boolean
- `budget` — empty string → null

**Flavour: Admin-assigned direct lead** (`targetVendorId` set, no `packageId`).

Lead is created with `status: PENDING_REVIEW`, `maxUnlocks: 1`. Admin still reviews; on approval, ONLY that vendor sees it in `/vendor/leads/direct`.

**Direct-lead vendor validation:** target vendor must be `role=VENDOR`, `isActive=true`, and `kycStatus=APPROVED`. Otherwise 400 with one of these codes:
- `TARGET_VENDOR_NOT_FOUND`
- `TARGET_VENDOR_INACTIVE`
- `TARGET_VENDOR_KYC_PENDING`

**Flavour: Package inquiry lead** (`packageId` set — customer inquired from a package detail page).

**Backend behaviour:**
- Loads the package; must be `APPROVED` and non-deleted, otherwise 400 `PACKAGE_NOT_AVAILABLE`.
- Sets `targetVendorId` = `package.vendorUserId` (any client-sent `targetVendorId` is ignored to prevent spoofing).
- Sets `destination` = `package.destination` (client's value is overridden for consistency).
- Sets `status: 'ACTIVE'` — **no admin review needed** (vendor is already trusted: KYC-approved + subscription + package admin-approved).
- Sets `maxUnlocks: 1` — only the target vendor can ever unlock.
- Sets `priceInCredits` = `plan.directLeadPriceCredits` from vendor's active subscription (fallback: 5 credits if vendor has no active sub).

**Vendor sees the lead immediately** in `/vendor/leads/direct` with the linked `package` summary — no waiting on admin.

**Response includes:** `fromPackage: true`, `isDirect: true`.

request.description: Full KYC payload — profile, kycStatus, verified documents, admin review info if any.

Calls Surepass PAN verification + saves the verified document. Idempotent — won't recharge the API if the PAN is already verified for this vendor.

**Body:** `{ number }` — the 10-character PAN. Auto-uppercased server-side.

Validates the GSTIN format (saves Surepass credits — no third-party call). Stores the document with `isVerified: true` once format passes.

**Body:** `{ number }` — the 15-character GSTIN.

Validates the CIN format. Same idea as GSTIN — saves third-party credits.

**Body:** `{ number }` — the 21-character CIN.

Returns a DigiLocker OAuth URL + `sessionId` (parked Surepass client_id). Open the URL in a browser, complete Aadhaar OAuth at DigiLocker. Save the `sessionId` to the env as `{{digilockerSessionId}}` for Step 2.

**Body:** `{ number }` — the 12-digit Aadhaar number.

Fetches the verified Aadhaar data from DigiLocker via the parked Surepass session. Idempotent — won't refetch if Aadhaar is already verified for this vendor.

**Body:** `{ sessionId }` — the value returned from Step 1 (initiate).

request.description:
Persists company-level fields and flips `kycStatus → SUBMITTED`.

**Side effects:** `User.isActive = false`, all refresh tokens revoked, vendor appears in admin review queue.

**Pre-req:** PAN must be third-party verified. Returns 422 if not.

**Field reference:**
- `companyType` — one of: `PROPRIETORSHIP`, `PARTNERSHIP`, `LLP`, `PVT_LTD`, `PUBLIC_LTD`, `OTHER` (aliases accepted: `'PRIVATE LIMITED'`, `'PVT LTD'`, etc.)
- `companySince` — years in business (integer)
- `companyLogo` — Cloudinary URL (use `/uploads/image` first)
- `profileUrl` — your website URL
- `referralSource` — `REFERENCE`, `GOOGLE`, `SOCIAL_MEDIA`, `ADVERTISEMENT`, `OTHER`
- `marketplaceWorked` — `"YES"` / `"NO"` / boolean
- `agreeTerms` & `declareTrue` — booleans (legal declaration)
Reachability check (VENDOR only).

query.description: Filter by traveler's departure city. Case-INSENSITIVE contains (top-level column since 2026-06-26).
ISO date — leads with travelDate on/after
ISO date — leads with travelDate on/before. Combine with travelFrom for a window.
Hide leads YOU already unlocked (true / false)

request.description:
Lists ACTIVE leads only. Email/phone are masked (`r***@gmail.com`, `98****1332`) until vendor unlocks. Each item includes `isUnlocked: boolean` so the UI knows whether to show 'Unlock' or 'View' button.

**All filters are optional — enable from Postman's query params panel as needed.**

Common use cases:
- Premium leads only: `?budgetMin=100000`
- Sasti unlock chahiye: `?priceMax=10`
- Fresh leads (last 7 days): `?createdFrom=2026-06-18`
- Hide already-bought: `?excludeUnlocked=true`
- Sort by highest budget: `?sortBy=budget&order=desc`

Atomic transaction:
1. Verifies lead is ACTIVE
2. CAS-reserves an unlock slot
3. CAS-debits the wallet
4. Writes a DEBIT_LEAD_UNLOCK ledger row
5. Creates LeadAssignment
6. Marks lead EXHAUSTED if last slot consumed

**Errors:**
- 402 `INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS`
- 409 `ALREADY_UNLOCKED` / `LEAD_EXHAUSTED` / `LEAD_NOT_ACTIVE`

Auto-saves `assignmentId` to env.

item.name: Admin — Vendor KYC
item.description: Review queue for KYC submissions. Approve to activate vendor, reject to send them back with a reason.

request.description: Use `status=SUBMITTED` to get the review queue.

Sets `kycStatus = APPROVED`, `isActive = true`. Vendor can now log in + use marketplace.

**Allowed from 2 states:**
- `SUBMITTED → APPROVED` — normal review-time approval.
- `REJECTED → APPROVED` — mistake-undo when admin accidentally rejected. Audit log distinguishes the two cases (`KYC_REJECTION_REVERTED_AND_APPROVED` for the latter).

Sets `kycStatus = REJECTED`, `isActive = true` (so vendor can log in to see the reason + resubmit). `reason` is required (min 5 chars).

**Allowed from 2 states:**
- `SUBMITTED → REJECTED` — normal review-time rejection.
- `APPROVED → REJECTED` — mistake-undo when admin accidentally approved. Same endpoint, same body. Audit log distinguishes the two cases (`KYC_APPROVAL_REVERTED_AND_REJECTED` for the latter).

item.name: Admin — Leads
item.description: The lead approval workflow. Review queue, approve/reject/close (single endpoint), and re-pricing.

query.description: PENDING_REVIEW | ACTIVE | EXHAUSTED | EXPIRED | REJECTED | CLOSED

Soft-delete — stamps `deletedAt = now()` and force-flips `isActive = false`. Plan disappears from all catalogs.

**Existing vendor subs on this plan continue to their natural `expiresAt`** — deletion only retires the catalog entry, no vendor-facing disruption.

**Irreversible** — deleted plans cannot be reactivated. Idempotent (calling twice returns the same state).

item.name: Super Admin — Subscriptions
item.description:
Vendor subscription power actions. SUPER_ADMIN only.

Matches the pattern used for other sensitive vendor actions (credit grant/revoke, vendor activate/deactivate) — reads are open to ADMIN, but writes that touch a live vendor's paid state require SUPER_ADMIN.

request.description:
Guarded cancel — only succeeds if the sub is currently ACTIVE. Reason (5-500 chars) is REQUIRED for the audit trail.

**Real-world use cases:**
- Vendor requested cancellation via support
- Refund initiated — closing paid access
- Fraud detected — killing fraudulent subscription
- Payment reconciliation issue — vendor got a sub but the payment did not clear
- T&C violation — revoking service

**What it does:** Flips the sub to `CANCELLED`, stamps `cancelledAt` + `cancelledBy`, logs an audit line.

**What it does NOT do (yet):**
- Refund credits already granted (wallet untouched)
- Refund money via Razorpay (payment integration is a later phase)
- Notify the vendor via email/SMS

**Errors:**
- 404 — sub not found
- 409 `SUB_NOT_ACTIVE` — already EXPIRED / CANCELLED / UPGRADED

item.name: Vendor — Subscriptions
item.description:
Vendor's own plan catalog + buy / upgrade / current / history. VENDOR role.

**Direct-buy MVP:** No payment gateway. Buying a plan immediately activates it and grants the plan's `includedCredits` to the wallet. Razorpay verification will slot in front of buy/upgrade in a later phase.

**Upgrade — Add Days:** Old sub's remaining value is converted into bonus days on the new plan at the new plan's daily rate. Vendor pays full new-plan price up front, gets extra time instead.

**Credits — Additive:** New plan's credits stack on top of whatever the vendor already had. Old credits never expire.

request.description:
Fresh purchase. Returns the new sub + `walletBalanceAfter` (post-credit-grant).

**Errors:**
- 404 — plan not found or inactive
- 409 `ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION_EXISTS` — vendor already has an ACTIVE sub (use **Upgrade** instead)

exec: console.log('Upgraded. New sub:', res.data.subscription.id, '| Bonus days:', res.data.bonusDaysGranted, '| Wallet:', res.data.walletBalanceAfter);

request.description:
Upgrade to a pricier plan. Set `planId` to the target plan's id (NOT the current one).

**Formula:**
```
remainingValue = (daysRemaining / oldPlan.durationDays) * oldPlan.priceInPaise
bonusDays      = ceil(remainingValue / (newPlan.priceInPaise / newPlan.durationDays))
newExpiresAt   = now + newPlan.durationDays + bonusDays
```

**Errors:**
- 400 — no active sub / already on this plan
- 400 `DOWNGRADE_BLOCKED` — new plan is cheaper than current
- 404 — plan not found or inactive
- 409 `CONCURRENT_UPGRADE` — someone else touched the old sub between check and update

Current ACTIVE subscription (or `null` if none).

**`effectiveStatus`:** Reflects real-world state — if the DB row is still ACTIVE but `expiresAt` has passed, this field returns `EXPIRED` even before the daily cron catches up.
All of the vendor's past + current subs. Handy for the vendor's account/billing page. UPGRADED rows include `replacedBySubscriptionId` linking to the successor.
